csf2_core.json.download_instructions: Click 'Download English (xlsx)', save as data/csf/source/csf2.xlsx, then run: .venv/bin/python ./scripts/parse_crosswalk.py --output ./data
csf2_core.json.notes: Stable — NIST updates only when a new CSF version is published. Parsed alongside OLIR files from csf2.xlsx.

olir_iso27001.json.download_instructions: Same file as csf2_core — run parse_crosswalk.py after downloading data/csf/source/csf2.xlsx
olir_iso27001.json.notes: Parsed from the ISO 27001 references column in the NIST CPRT export.

olir_pcidss.json.download_instructions: Same file as csf2_core — run parse_crosswalk.py after downloading data/csf/source/csf2.xlsx
olir_pcidss.json.notes: Parsed from the PCI DSS references column in the NIST CPRT export. Not the official PCI SSC OLIR.

domain_weights.json.notes: Caizin internal judgment — update manually as engagement patterns evolve.

tier_definitions.json.notes: Static — tied to the CSF 2.0 framework version. Only changes if NIST publishes a new CSF version.

ai/source/AI_RMF_Playbook.pdf.source: NIST AI RMF Playbook (AI Resource Center)
ai/source/AI_RMF_Playbook.pdf.download_instructions: Download the Playbook PDF and save as data/ai/source/AI_RMF_Playbook.pdf
ai/source/AI_RMF_Playbook.pdf.notes: Primary question-content source for the AI RMF banks (72 subcategories with Suggested Actions). Freshness: each AI output records the SHA-256 of the sources it was built from; check_freshness.py --ai-bank compares them with the files on disk.
